name: Horned Devil
summary: A winged devil that wields a searing fork, lashes its tail, and hurls flame.

traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
traits.text: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The devil makes three attacks, using Searing Fork or Hurl Flame in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Infernal Tail.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.onHit: If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts burning.

actions.name: Infernal Tail

save.targets: one creature the devil can see within 10 feet

actions.onFailure: and the target receives an infernal wound if it doesn't have one. While wounded, the target loses {dmg:3d6} Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores Hit Points to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to stanch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a {dc=17} Wisdom (Medicine) check.
